successCriteria.description: Create src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts exporting the LeaveBalance interface with exactly these attributes: id (string), employeeId (string), leavePolicyId (string), totalEntitlement (number), usedDays (number), remainingDays (number), pendingDays (number), fiscalYear (number), status (BalanceStatus, imported from src/shared/types/leave.types.ts), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date).
Create src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts exporting the LeaveBalanceQueryParams type for filtering balance queries.

Create src/modules/balance/balance.repository.ts exporting the ILeaveBalanceRepository interface with exactly these six method signatures: findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string): Promise<LeaveBalance[]>; findByEmployeeAndPolicy(employeeId: string, leavePolicyId: string, fiscalYear: number): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>; create(balance: Omit<LeaveBalance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeaveBalance>; update(id: string, changes: Partial<LeaveBalance>): Promise<LeaveBalance>; deductDays(id: string, days: number): Promise<LeaveBalance>; addPendingDays(id: string, days: number): Promise<LeaveBalance>.

Create tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.repository.test.ts with Jest unit tests that verify the ILeaveBalanceRepository interface contract — tests should validate method signatures exist and accept correct parameter types (structural typing checks via TypeScript compilation).
BalanceStatus must be imported from src/shared/types/leave.types.ts (Phase 1) — no redefinition, no local enum.

constraints: LeaveBalance interface must use BalanceStatus enum imported from src/shared/types/leave.types.ts — no local redefinition.
ILeaveBalanceRepository is an interface only — no concrete implementation in this phase.
All files must pass TypeScript strict mode compilation (no implicit any, strict null checks per AGENTS.md).
Tests must use Jest and follow the existing pattern from tests/unit/shared/types/leave.types.test.ts (describe/it blocks, structural assertions).
outOfScope: Concrete repository implementation (PgLeaveBalanceRepository) — deferred to a later phase.
Balance service, controller, routes, and index.ts — deferred to later phases (Phase 6 per PLAN.md).
Database migrations, DDL, or schema definitions for leave_balances table.
Business rule enforcement (BR-001 balance sufficiency, BR-008 balance reservation) — these belong to the service layer in later phases.
Audit logging (GP-002) — no state-changing operations exist in this phase (interface-only).

ambiguities.description: LeaveBalanceQueryParams type has no fields specified in the intent. It is mentioned as a deliverable but its shape is undefined. Likely intended as a filter type for findByEmployeeId queries (e.g., optional fiscalYear, status filters).
options: Define it as an empty type alias for now (type LeaveBalanceQueryParams = Record<string, never>)
Define it with optional fiscalYear and status fields matching common query patterns
Omit it entirely since no method signature references it
